With,Ⓒprep.ⒹGen. ex. by instr.
Ⓑ
 2 (Manner) by instr.; prItyA ‘w(ith) affection’; by comp. with sa; saharzaM, saBayaM &c.; pUrvaM, pUrvakaM in comp.; ‘w(ith) respect’ mAnapuraHsaraM, AdarapUrvakaM.

Ⓑ
 4 (With verbs) saM; ‘to live w(ith)’ saM-vas.
Ⓑ
 5 (On the side of) pakze.
Ⓑ
 6 (In the option of) matena, mate (tava matenAkiMcitkaramidaM); ‘w(ith) all’ anAdftya; See ‘in spite or’ under Spite.
Ⓝ[With]al,Ⓒadv.ⒹsamaM, taTA ca, api ca, taTEva.
